anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex, bulbous arc representing a significant anterior-dorsal protrusion with a smooth curvature.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt protrusion with a high thickness-to-length ratio, appearing stubby relative to the melon size.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: An obtuse transition angle visible at the junction where the steep melon slope levels into the dorsal rostrum surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Broad, spatulate pectoral fins and a deeply recessed median notch at the trailing edge of the caudal flukes.
